data.description: The S Bridge Climber bends its overhead ladder into an S curve, so children must change direction halfway across. The ladder is red and sits on yellow poles, with a side ladder at each end for getting up and down. Turning mid-crossing asks children to plan each reach and shift their body weight, which is harder than a straight run of bars. It covers 13' x 7'5", with a safe play area of 18' x 12'5". This climber gives older children a fresh challenge in a school ground or park where a plain monkey bar is already in place. Colours are Play Red and Play Yellow. Galvanised pipe on this frame carries a 3-year warranty. Send us your site plan and we will mark the safe play area for you.

props.pText: The S-shaped ladder and its supporting poles are galvanised steel, which resists rust in wet weather. It can be installed self-standing or grouted. Children can drop from points across the width of the curve. Cover the full 18' x 12'5" area with an impact-absorbing surface and check the joints at each bend during maintenance.
